name: Build Interactive Field Route
description: Interactive v2 of an existing visual benchmark; deterministic behavior checks and explicit evidence semantics. Original case remains available for historical comparisons.
prompt: Create a polished responsive self-contained map-route-planner-v2.html with inline HTML/CSS/JavaScript only. No network, dependencies or other files. Use accessible keyboard/touch controls, 44px targets and reduced-motion-friendly transitions. Five stops in order: Start, Signal bridge, Memory grove, Watchtower, Finish. Clicking a numbered stop updates current position and next action; Next clamps at Finish, Reset returns to Start. Add a user-started watch tour, a spatial route that actually connects the stops, progress and non-color cues. Expose window.evaluationDemo.select(index), next(), reset(), getState() returning {index,label,next,complete}; next is null at Finish. Reject invalid indices. Source and state checks do not certify rendered quality.

benchmark.intent: Evaluate meaningful interaction and information accuracy, beyond static text matching.
